Title: Split the hardened request app from Runtime Lite and connect the RIDES view
Problem / Request: The user-provided request app includes email confirmation and Calendar permissions that do not belong in the narrow Runtime Lite project. Replace the merged embedded writer with a read-only adapter to the shared DEV Ride Requests sheet, preserve the RIDES cockpit, and use the separate hardened request-app bundle for intake, signed driver decisions, email, and calendar events.
Acceptance Criteria: Runtime Lite reads but never creates or updates the Ride Requests sheet; the embedded request form and pulseSubmitFriendRide/pulseUpdateFriendRideStatus endpoints are removed; RIDES shows requested and confirmed records plus the next confirmed ride; the private link comes from PULSE_FRIEND_REQUEST_URL; ?mode=test remains deterministic and no-write; the separate request-app bundle uses action-specific expiring signatures, explicit lifecycle rules, consent, duplicate suppression, email receipts/decisions, Calendar events, and its own manifest; production is untouched; CI passes; no automatic deployment.
Branch / Build: 11 reviewed operations / 4 modules staged; companion request-app bundle built
